stories.title: IMF flags AI selloff, war and debt as risks to global economy
stories.summary: The IMF warned of complacency in financial markets, citing risks from an AI-driven market correction, rising government-bond yields and cyberattacks as threats to otherwise-resilient markets.

stories.title: The Oct. 7 attack changed Israel, but not its politics
stories.summary: As Israelis head to the polls this month, the NYT reports the 2023 Hamas attack has left the country more polarized than ever rather than producing political transformation.

stories.title: IMF: AI boom boosted global trade growth, benefiting China and India
stories.summary: The IMF chief economist said strong AI demand has outpaced overall global-trade growth and lifted China, India and other Asian economies.

stories.title: IMF: AI investment keeps global growth above 3% despite war and debt
stories.summary: The IMF World Economic Outlook, released at its annual meetings in Bangkok, sees global GDP topping 3% this year as AI investment offsets the Middle East energy shock, but warns downside risks are mounting.

stories.title: Scaleway to build AMD-powered AI supercomputer in Sweden
stories.summary: The French cloud company announced its first AI supercomputer outside France, built on AMD chips, at its annual AI conference in Paris.

stories.title: Apple to unveil new smart home products showcasing updated Siri AI
stories.summary: Apple is set to reveal fresh smart home hardware that highlights its overhauled, AI-based Siri assistant.

stories.title: Scientists call for international body to oversee advanced AI
stories.summary: Researchers are urging the creation of an international governance body to oversee the development of frontier AI systems.

stories.title: Character.AI files for bankruptcy, agrees to sell assets for $20M
stories.summary: The AI chatbot startup has filed for bankruptcy and reached a deal to sell some assets for about $20 million.

stories.title: Cleveland City Council designates Oct. 13 as Bernie Kosar Day
stories.summary: Cleveland is honoring the Browns legend with an official Bernie Kosar Day resolution to recognize his contributions to the team and city.

stories.title: 5 betting lessons after Verstappen wins Singapore GP
stories.summary: Analysis of the wagering takeaways from Max Verstappen's victory in the Singapore Grand Prix.

stories.title: Norris concedes he let down McLaren with Piastri clash
stories.summary: Lando Norris apologized to McLaren after an intra-team collision with Oscar Piastri in the Singapore sprint, saying he let the team down.

stories.title: How Hamilton's call helped put Antonelli in reach of the title
stories.summary: Breakdown of how Lewis Hamilton's Singapore strategy call put Mercedes teammate Andrea Kimi Antonelli within reach of the drivers' title.

stories.title: Central Ohio cities debate Flock camera usage
stories.summary: Columbus-area communities are weighing how to use Flock automatic license-plate camera systems as privacy and effectiveness questions persist.

stories.title: One killed in South Side Columbus shooting
stories.summary: A person was found dead in an alley on Columbus's South Side, the latest fatal shooting in the city.

stories.title: Dip in Columbus gas prices doesn't erase $4 per gallon average
stories.summary: A recent slide in local pump prices has not brought the Columbus average below $4 a gallon.
